_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Lumen OS: SHA-256 of the DER of each PUBLIC AOSP test certificate (build/make/target/product/security/*.x509.pem, Lineage 21 uses them unchanged; copies in tools/sign/testcerts) -> the Lumen release key (~/.lumen-keys/<name>.pk8 + .x509.pem) that replaces it. sign_tar.py re-signs every APK whose signer is a key here, rewrites the SELinux mac_permissions certs, and fails on any APK signed by an unmapped Android test-looking certificate.

known_test_only.ce7b2b47ae2b7552c8f92cc29124279883041fb6: cts_uicc_2021 (CTS carrier-privilege test cert; never signs a system APK; listed so the leftover scan knows it)

presigned_known.91370e897e35bd90a262b73e8296661819c13d54: MindTheGapps release key (com.mtg.* overlays such as ATVOverlay; same DN as the AOSP test keys, but a third-party key: kept as shipped)

apex._comment: APEX policy since 2026-10-07 (docs/keys.md#apex, tools/sign/apex_sign.py): every APEX in the image is re-signed. Per module <m> (the apex_manifest name = the file name without .apex/.capex): payload key ~/.lumen-keys/apex/<m>.pem (RSA-4096, AVB hashtree footer; public: <m>.avbpubkey = the apex_pubkey entry, <m>.pubkey.pem) and container key ~/.lumen-keys/apex/<m>.pk8 + <m>.x509.pem (RSA-4096). Public copies in tools/sign/release_certs/apex/. An APEX whose module is not listed here FAILS the run (a new module needs a decision + gen_keys.sh). APKs inside APEXes: a mapped AOSP test certificate -> its release key (test_certs above); any other certificate with O=Android (an AOSP module development key from the source tree, e.g. com.android.connectivity.resources) -> inner_apk_default; anything else FAILS.
